summary: Destructor-style cleanup: frees three auxiliary pointers, sets one field to -1.0, then frees a dynamic array of 316-byte elements (count from a 4-byte header) by walking backward and calling a destructor stub on each element, and zeroes the owning fields.

operations.description: If pointer at this+0x150 is nonzero it is freed

If pointer at this+0x158 is nonzero it is freed
Free the three auxiliary pointers via FreeWrapper_7bcf
Zero the three auxiliary pointers and set field at this+0x148 to -1.0
If array pointer at this+0x134 is nonzero its elements are released
Walk the array backward from element count (read from header at result-4) and call EmptyStub_0170 on each 316-byte element, then free the header
Zero array pointer at this+0x134, count at this+0x138 and field at this+0x130
Return the last freed header value
